collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: A young goat follows a villager all the way to the garden.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: A young goat follows (name1) all the way to the garden. It nibbles at a weed and seems very pleased with itself.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: A young goat follows (name1) all the way to the garden. (name1) leads it back home, and it follows just as happily.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: A young goat follows (name1) all the way to the garden. The goat refuses to leave until (name1) scratches behind its ears.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: A young goat follows (name1) all the way to the garden. A child arrives breathless, looking for it, and thanks (name1).
